country: # Wadden Sea spots lie in the national park: kite only in the marked zones

name: Sylt – Westerland
notes: Brandenburger Strand: Germany's main wave spot, strong current between the groynes. Experienced riders.

name: Sylt – List (Königshafen)
notes: Wadden Sea, shallow flat water. Nature reserve: launch only from the kite beach, ride inside the buoys, about 2–3 h either side of high tide.

name: Sylt – K4 (Hörnum)
notes: West beach 4 km north of Hörnum: flat channels at low tide, waves at high tide; strong coastal current.

name: Sylt – Hörnum Möwennest
notes: Wadden side behind the Möwennest hostel: flat shallow water for E winds. National park: only about 2–3 h either side of low tide.

name: Dagebüll
notes: Wadden Sea, by the ferry pier; around high tide only.

name: Nordstrand – Holmer Siel
notes: Wadden Sea: about 5 h around high tide; groyne fields (Lahnungen) at low water.

name: Husum – Dockkoog
notes: Wadden Sea, around high tide. Busy in summer; no-go channel south of the point.

name: Sankt Peter-Ording
notes: Ording beach (kite world cup venue): huge beach, flat to small waves, tide-dependent; strong current at times.

name: Büsum – Perlebucht
notes: Northern part of the Perlebucht lagoon only; tidal, ride around high tide.

name: Cuxhaven – Kugelbake
notes: Elbe mouth: current and shipping lane. National park zone, about 3 h either side of high tide.

name: Cuxhaven – Sahlenburg
notes: Large standing area; about 4 h either side of high tide.

name: Otterndorf
notes: Elbe estuary: strong tidal current and shipping lane nearby; ride around high tide.

name: Dorum-Neufeld
notes: Wadden Sea, shallow: about 3 h either side of high tide. Channels are shipping lanes.

name: Wremen
notes: Wadden Sea, large standing area: about 3.5 h either side of high tide.

name: Butjadingen – Tossens
notes: Wadden Sea, shallow; about 3 h either side of high tide.

name: Hooksiel
notes: Jade, shallow; ride around high tide.

name: Schillig
notes: Wadden Sea, shallow; ride around high tide. Kite school on site.

name: Neuharlingersiel
notes: Wadden Sea; about 3.5 h either side of high tide.

name: Norddeich
notes: Wadden Sea, kite area by the surf school; ride around high tide.

name: Norderney – Nordstrand
notes: Marked kite zone on the north beach; island rules limit the hours (not early morning).

name: Borkum – Nordstrand
notes: Marked kite zone on the north beach; island rules limit the hours (not early morning).

name: Langeoog – Nordstrand
notes: Sportstrand on the north beach: waves at high tide, shallow at low tide; island rules limit the hours.

name: Flensburger Förde – Holnis
notes: Fjord spot, shallow near shore; marked kite zone in summer.

name: Flensburger Förde – Schausende
notes: Fjord spot with a small standing area; boat traffic and occasional nets.

name: Laboe
notes: Kiel Fjord mouth, shallow and flat near shore.

name: Stein
notes: About 200 m of standing area, flat to wavy.

name: Heiligenhafen
notes: Steinwarder, east of the pier: wind waves, beginner zone in the shallows.

name: Großenbrode
notes: Flat water and small waves.

name: Fehmarn – Gold
notes: Huge shallow standing area, busy with schools; stones in the north part.

name: Fehmarn – Lemkenhafen (Orther Reede)
notes: Flat shallow water in the Orther Reede.

name: Fehmarn – Wulfener Hals
notes: Flat shallow water in the bay, small waves outside; best in E winds.

name: Fehmarn – Grüner Brink
notes: North coast: works in E winds when other spots are offshore; shared with a dog beach.

name: Pelzerhaken
notes: Long sandy beach, shallow; flat to small waves.

name: Salzhaff – Pepelow
notes: Salzhaff: shallow flat-water lagoon, ideal for learning.

name: Warnemünde
notes: Kite access at beach access 13, west of the pier; rough waves in strong N–NW wind.

name: Wustrow
notes: Baltic side: waves (German Kitesurf Open venue). Bodden side: flat shallow water.

name: Saal (Saaler Bodden)
notes: Shallow flat water almost everywhere; kite school on site.

name: Zingst
notes: Sportstrand at the edge of town; choppy, deep enough for foiling.

name: Rügen – Suhrendorf (Ummanz)
notes: Bodden: shallow flat water, beginner-friendly.

name: Rügen – Dranske
notes: Wieker Bodden side: flat water.

name: Rügen – Wiek
notes: Wieker Bodden: flat shallow water.

name: Gahlkow
notes: Greifswalder Bodden: narrow beach, choppy and gusty.

name: Usedom – Peenemünde
notes: Choppy, deepens quickly; few facilities.

name: Usedom – Karlshagen
notes: Sportstrand with kite school; waves in E winds, W winds are offshore. Keep clear of the swimming zone.

name: Usedom – Ückeritz (Achterwasser)
notes: Achterwasser by the harbour: standing area, choppy; best W–S.

name: Steinhuder Meer
notes: Mardorf / Weißer Berg on the north shore: about 500 m of standing area. Kiting roughly 20 Mar–15 Nov in the marked zone.

name: Dümmer
notes: Shallow lake; launch at the surf entry point (Rohrdommel).

name: Brombachsee
notes: Großer Brombachsee: occasional afternoon thermals. Kiting April–June and September–November.
